mechanism: Time from 'Employee submitted' to the Supervisor decision that follows it
measures: Elapsed calendar time between the two recorded events. Includes queueing, nights, weekends, notification delay and waiting for information. Not review time.
estimable_note: Not review latency: 93% of these gaps are under an hour, so the two events are recorded together or the step is near-instant; the log cannot tell which.

value.interval_95_meaning: central 95% of observed gaps (2.5th to 97.5th percentile), not a CI

conditions: Eindhoven University of Technology travel expense declarations (domestic), 2017 two departments, 2018 whole university; staff anonymised to roles; Employee submitted then Supervisor

source.name: BPI Challenge 2020: Domestic Declarations
source.creator: Boudewijn van Dongen, Eindhoven University of Technology
